targetId.description:
The id of the target for the mask. The type of the target is either
an {@link ExpectedSensor} or a {@link Sensor}.

targetType.description: A string enum representing the type of the target.

operator.description: The string that represents the operator that will be applied to the mask.

value.description: Threshold on which to apply the operator.

title:
Type that represents a rule mask for dataset preparation settings. This is used for any mask that is applied based
on one or more sensors' values. Through the UI, non-operational and training/inference rule masks all
represent instances of these rule masks.
name: ReliabilityDataPreparationRuleMaskSpec
